status: Private Wizard Fireball repair/rework component stage. Runtime remains unselected and unpublished until a coherent complete Wizard class pass. Full release goal remains active.
changes: All three stable existing Fireball rune IDs now have actual offline consumers. Empowered doubles the already rounded trained/Focused projectile and adds3s to base cooldown before discounts. Chain retains three additional half-damage direct hits, selects reachable unhit targets and refreshes its damage snapshot once per bounce frame. Paid rune/training/damage snapshots survive later loadout changes.

Magma replaces the former authoritative following-bleed approximation with its advertised stationary5-unit/3s ground field. It inherits one-sixth of the first resolved hit, applies current receiving defenses and ordinary per-recipient PvP caps once, and cannot follow departed enemies, cross cover, reroll crits/outgoing modifiers or consume another Focus charge. Fully absorbed/Phase-blocked hits create no free field.

MagmaGround is a dedicated authoritative subtype. Its production replicated projectile visual delegates to the same quality-aware BurningGround factory, animation and resource owner as offline play. Root/protobuf checks retain type/scale/owner and exclude private budget flags. Current effective renderer quality drives local and reconstructed fields.

Offline fields avoid consuming their birth chunk frame. Three-second timing is verified through ordinary chunk updates at native High and15FPS Low; retired fields detach their meshes. Received-damage observations now survive death-save heals, rather than inferring hit budgets from net HP changes. Existing ability-helper return semantics remain unchanged.

Lance visual metadata now matches captured1/.5/2.5 collision radii. Arcane Barrage text describes two extra missiles so all precision rune variants retain accurate combo guidance. No new rune IDs, saved-build resets, character replacements, asset/dependency changes or production deployment.
